articles.summary: Increase Results in 3.4% Year-Over-Year Growth Agree Realty Corporation (NYSE: ADC) (the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized, and the Company has declared, a monthly cash dividend of $0.271 per common share, representing a 1.5% month-over-month increase. The monthly dividend reflects an annualized dividend amount of $3.252 per common share, representing a 3.4% increase over the annualized dividend amount of $3.144 per common share from the fourth quarter of 2025. The dividend is payable November 13, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on October 30, 2026. Additionally, the Company’s Board of Directors has authorized, and the Company has declared, a monthly cash dividend on its 4.25% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock of $0.08854 per depositary share, which is equivalent to $1.0625 per annum. The dividend is payable November 2, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on October 23, 2026. About Agree
articles.title: Agree Realty Declares Increased Monthly Common Dividend
